soft_event_news.title: Ford Motor Reports First-Quarter 2026 U.S. Vehicle Sales - The Globe and Mail
soft_event_news.body:
Ford Motor ( (F) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On April 2, 2026, Ford Motor Co. issued a news release detailing its U.S. vehicle sales performance for the first quarter of 2026, providing an update on how its models and brands fared in the domestic market. The filing of this sales release as part of its official report underscores the importance of quarterly U.S. sales metrics for investors and other stakeholders tracking Ford’s operational momentum and market position.

The most recent analyst rating on (F) stock is a Sell with a $10.00 price target. To see the full list of analyst forecasts on Ford Motor stock, see the F Stock Forecast page.

According to Spark, TipRanks’ AI Analyst, F is a Neutral.

The score is held down primarily by weaker financial quality (high leverage and volatile profitability despite strong cash flow) and bearish technical momentum (below key moving averages with negative MACD). Partially offsetting these are a high dividend yield and earnings-call guidance that points to improving 2026 EBIT/FCF, though meaningful EV losses, restructuring charges, and back-half execution risks remain.

To see Spark’s full report on F stock, click here.

Ford Motor Co. is a global automotive manufacturer that designs, produces, and sells cars, trucks, and sport-utility vehicles, as well as providing related mobility and financial services. The company focuses primarily on the mass-market and commercial vehicle segments, competing across North America and worldwide in both retail and fleet markets.
